title: Fall is a Great Time to Get in Shape
headings: Some other benefits of getting shape during fall include:
paragraphs: If you want to find some healthy habits to maintain the hard work you’ve done throughout the year, the fall season is a great time to focus on remaining motivated. In the summer, hot temperatures can make outdoor exercise unappealing, and it can even be dangerous. But autumn’s more moderate temperatures are great for outdoor activity. There is not extreme heat, and you can comfortably workout outdoors. It is a great way to spend more time in nature and fresh air.
